purpose: One-time prospective data-disjoint synthetic holdout after existing configuration selection; not independent author, human or real-user blind evaluation

dataset_plan.source_overlap: No reused document bodies, titles, question text or family labels from prior benchmark versions; related retrieval phenomena deliberately remain covered

secondary: FinalTop5 evidence recall and losses separate from pool; negative candidates not refusal quality; no exhaustive precision claim
selection: Evaluate frozen candidate against both absolute gates and per-evidence default regressions; no choose-new-configuration step
stop_rules: No code/config/question/gold changes after first scored query
Do not keep trying variants or increase budgets if gates fail
Report every failed category and missing evidence; no deployment in this task
Infrastructure failures may be rerun identically; retain failed run status
After results are viewed this dataset is exposed regression, no longer unseen holdout
limitations: Same assistant authors new data after seeing prior experiments; knowledge of earlier failures may influence design
Synthetic themed sources and questions share an author; lexical/style correlations remain
New source families do not establish real production distribution or statistical independence
One serial pass per configuration; separate rebuilt indexes; no small candidate-rank causality or production latency conclusion
No human relevance adjudication or runtime permission/fault-injection acceptance
